is: The HTTP-free composition root shared by every driving adapter (api, cli): loads Config and wires the live Runtime bag of domain ports.
conventions: HTTP-free by construction, enforced by `tests/no_http_deps.rs` — never add axum/tower-sessions here or to `cli`.

Composition builds the migrator; the driver runs it (`Runtime::connect_migrating` hands back the `CustodyMigrator`, `api` runs it at boot). Background tasks, sessions and cookies are explicitly NOT this crate's concern — left to the driver.
The Runtime→`application::*Ports` conversion lives once in `src/ports.rs` (one `From<&Runtime>` per application module); drivers never hand-assemble a Ports struct.
Never reaches the Den's node port nor names Atta's checked-name constructor: `application/tests/node_and_name_seams.rs` scans this crate's `src/` too.

The custody root never sits in `Config` nor in figment's value map (the env provider ignores `did_key_root_key`): only a command that holds a purpose reads it, as a `!Send` `RootSecret`, and `src/custody.rs` is the one file that names `KeyCustodian` or `adapter_hkdf` (held by `application/tests/custody_seams.rs`, over every driver crate's `src/`, aliases included, beside the check that the guard runs before the one derivation). No `KeyCustodian` is a `Runtime` field; `Runtime` stays `Send + Sync + Clone` (a compile-time assertion in `src/runtime.rs`).

fs.name: Cargo.toml
fs.role: deps — domain, application, adapter-pg, adapter-atproto, adapter-hkdf (the custody root's derivation), async-trait (the no-purpose custodian), zeroize, figment, serde, anyhow, tracing, tracing-subscriber (the shared log filter), base64 (the root's decode), fluent-uri, url, thiserror, derive_more; dev: figment's Jail, tokio, strum

fs.name: src/config.rs
fs.role: Config struct (no custody root: the env provider ignores `did_key_root_key` beside `build_id`; public_url a BareOrigin; build_id a BuildId read verbatim from ZURFUR_BUILD_ID — layered past the env provider so a numeric id stays text — defaulting to "unknown", an invalid one failing the load), figment loader (Config::load/load_from over `layered`, failing with LoadError: Figment or Refused) with the environment guard ConfigRefusal, Environment enum, boot-time custody guard ensure_custody_hardened

fs.name: src/config/origin.rs
fs.role: BareOrigin (TryFrom<Url>/FromStr refusing credentials, a path, a query, a fragment or no host; is_of_origin, is_public_https) and BareOriginError; tests in src/config/origin/tests.rs

fs.name: src/custody.rs
fs.role: the one custody function: the boot guard on the raw root, then `HkdfKeyCustodian::derive` of the purposes asked for, then `Custody`, the scoped handles only (`ScopedSealer<ForDidCustody>` for `PgKeyStore`, `ScopedSealer<ForSigninSecrets>` for the atproto authenticator, `ScopedMac` for the Den); `Custody::derive(RootSecret, env, plc_directory_submit, purposes)`, `Custody::default()` (no purpose, no root read: every handle answers PurposeNotHeld), `Custody::root_check()` → `CustodyRootCheck` (a private clone of the DID-custody handle, exposing only `run(&PgPool)`, which opens the first sealed custody row through `PgKeyStore::check_root`; not a `Runtime` field; the CLI's root check), and the crate-private copy of the root the custody migrator takes; the only file naming `KeyCustodian` and `adapter_hkdf`; tests in src/custody/tests.rs

fs.name: src/lib.rs
fs.role: crate doc + re-exports of Config, Custody, RootSecret (and ROOT_KEY_ENV, RootSecretError) and Runtime; runtime is pub(crate), ports and logging are pub

fs.name: src/logging.rs
fs.role: the log filter both drivers (api, cli) layer on their subscriber: every event from hickory's crates dropped whatever RUST_LOG says (hickory logs a queried handle's domain at error); is_loggable_target, and without_dns_client() -> impl Layer, a filter_fn over it

fs.name: src/ports.rs
fs.role: From<&Runtime> impls building application's `Ports` bag and `App`; the bag clones the runtime's ProfileLookups, so every request shares one set

fs.name: src/root.rs
fs.role: RootSecret, the custody root: 32 zeroizing bytes, not Clone, `!Send`/`!Sync` (a PhantomData<*const ()>), a redacted Debug; RootSecret::from_env reads ROOT_KEY_ENV (ZURFUR_DID_KEY_ROOT_KEY) into a Zeroizing<String>, TryFrom<Zeroizing<String>> decodes trimmed base64 into a wiped buffer, From<Zeroizing<[u8; 32]>>; RootSecretError (unset / not base64 / not 32 bytes) names the variable and the rule, never a character of the value; compile_fail doctests for Clone, Send and Sync; tests in src/root/tests.rs

fs.name: src/runtime.rs
fs.role: Runtime bag of Arc<dyn Port> (AccountStore, Authenticator, BugReportStore, ChangelogStore, CommissionStore, Database, DidMinter, FileStore, IdentityResolver, ProfileCache, ProfileSource, UserStore) plus the process-wide ProfileLookups (built once in `wire`, shared by every clone) and `den_mac`, the Den's MAC handle (PurposeNotHeld in a runtime connected without that purpose); Runtime::connect(config, Custody) wiring pg+atproto adapters (one AtprotoIdentityResolver shared by the authenticator and the profile source), Runtime::connect_migrating(config, RootSecret, purposes), which derives at the call and returns a Send future of (Runtime, CustodyMigrator), the migrator keeping a zeroizing copy of the root until it runs or drops; a compile-time Send + Sync + Clone assertion; transaction convenience; tests in src/runtime/tests.rs

fs.name: tests/no_http_deps.rs
fs.role: cargo-tree guard — composition and cli must never link an HTTP-server crate (axum, axum-core, tower-sessions)

notes: **Live adapter per port** (`Runtime::wire`): `auth`/`profile_source`/`did_minter` → adapter-atproto (`AtprotoAuthenticator`, `AtprotoProfileSource`, `RealDidMinter` over `PgKeyStore` + `PgPlcOperationLog` + the directory); every other port → adapter-pg (`PgUserStore`, `PgAccountStore`, `PgCommissionStore`, `PgChangelogStore`, `PgWorkflowStore`, `PgColumnStore`, `PgBugReportStore`, `PgFileStore`, `PgProfileCache` at a one-hour TTL, `PgDatabase`). Tests swap in the mem fakes. Adding a capability = a field on `Runtime` plus a line in `wire`.

Two ports are pool-backed on purpose, the documented exceptions to the unit of work: the `profile_cache` fill (a read-path write with no transactional invariant) and `files` (blob bytes cannot ride a transaction).

`Runtime::connect` connects the pool but deliberately does NOT run migrations. Composition builds the migrator; the driver runs it: `Runtime::connect_migrating` returns the `CustodyMigrator` (probe and dry run, the migrations, the re-wrap) beside the runtime, and `api` runs it at boot. `adapter_pg::migrate_fresh` is for fresh databases only.

Config layering, lowest first: `config/{profile}.toml` → the unprefixed `DATABASE_URL` (the name sqlx tooling expects) → `ZURFUR_*` env. `ZURFUR_ENV` both picks the profile file and deserializes into `Config::env`, so the two spellings must agree; it is validated as a bare name so it cannot walk out of the config dir. The config dir is anchored to `CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR`, never the CWD.
`handle_domain` is parsed into a `HandleDomain` ONCE at load, so the claim checks and the `/.well-known/atproto-did` resolver cannot disagree about the namespace (DD 26607618).

`Config::load` refuses a configuration its environment may not boot with (`ConfigRefusal`, ruling R-77, 2026-10-12; S1/N4 of security's review of #277). `public_url` is a `BareOrigin` (scheme, host, optional port; credentials, path, query and fragment fail the load, value-free, naming the rule; the Engineer's review of #285, 2026-10-12), so the guard checks only scheme, host and port: `DEV` only on `http://127.0.0.1` or `http://[::1]` (`BareOrigin::is_of_origin`, any port; never `localhost`, which Bluesky refuses as a loopback redirect host) with a loopback `http_addr`; `STG`/`PROD` only on `BareOrigin::is_public_https` (https on a domain name of two or more labels, not `localhost`, no IP literal, no trailing dot, port not 0); `STG` never on production's handle domain `zurfur.app` nor any subdomain of it (ruling R-79, 2026-10-12). The refusal comes back as `LoadError::Refused(ConfigRefusal)`, whose message names the setting and never echoes its value, so the CLI prints it as is; the CLI also prints `public_url`'s own value-free parse message.

`ensure_custody_hardened` is a boot-time refusal, not documentation: `PROD`/`STG` are refused outright while custody is config/env-root-backed, and PLC submission is refused under the shipped `EXAMPLE_DEV_ROOT_KEY` in any environment.

Purposes per driver: `api`'s everyday profile connects with all three (DidCustody, SigninSecrets, DenMac); its dev profile derives the DenMac purpose only, through `Custody::derive`; the CLI reads the root only for `account …` and `migrate` (DidCustody) and connects `health`, `session` and `bug-reports list` with `Custody::default()`, never reading the root.

`Config::DEFAULT_MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES` (50 MiB) is the one home for the upload cap. Raising it past `i32::MAX` bytes is a wire break — `byte_size` must then become an int64 decimal string (`contract/VERSIONING.md` §7.2).
See also: ZMVP-200 (crate extracted from api::AppState).
